title: Change Order Credits Applied to a Past-Due Reconstruction Draw Payment
content:
Change order credits on a Reconstruction contract are applied to the payment of the oldest unpaid customer-funded draw, which the draw a past-due payment brings current is.

**Rule.** When change order credit lines were posted on the contract within the past month and their total is below the draw's unpaid amount, their total is subtracted; when their total is at or above the draw's unpaid amount, only the draw's unpaid amount is subtracted and the rest stays on the contract; otherwise nothing is subtracted.

**The past month.** Counting back one month from the payment date, a date is within the past month when it falls after the same day of the month in the previous calendar month and on or before the payment date; when the previous calendar month has no such day, every date in that previous month is outside the past month.

## Cases (hypothetical figures, draw unpaid $3,600.00)

| Change order credit lines posted on the contract within the past month | Subtracted from the payment | Stays on the contract |
|---|---|---|
| none | nothing | — |
| $820.00 | $820.00 | — |
| $3,600.00 | $3,600.00 | nothing |
| $4,100.00 | $3,600.00 | $500.00 |

**Month-end check (hypothetical).** On a payment date of the 31st of May, a credit posted on the 30th of April is outside the past month, because April has no 31st; a credit posted on the 1st of May is inside it.
